## Rule

ARC-GEN source `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_54d9e175.py`: width is always 11 and height is 3 or 7. Gray (`5`) separators occupy columns 3 and 7, plus row 3 when two panels are present. Marker colors `1..4` appear at panel centers `(4r+1, 4c+1)` and each marker paints its whole 3x3 panel block as `color + 5` in the output. There are no background `0` cells in the active output.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
compact = Conv1x1_stride4(input, W_desc, pads=[-1, -1, -24, -20])
output = grouped_ConvTranspose(compact, W_paint, stride=4, pads=[1, 1, -23, -19])
```

Current best is `staged_submits/task127_direct_descriptor_cost330/task127.onnx`. The first `Conv` samples marker centers directly from the full one-hot input into `[1,5,2,3]` descriptors: panel-exists, `1-vs-2`, and `3-vs-4` plus two zero alignment channels. The grouped `ConvTranspose` writes the final output, so the 30x30 output is free. This is byte-equal to the Aditya 396 team-best while deleting the charged marker Slice/Cast intermediates.

## Cost analysis

Source of truth for this run is `Agenters/Orchestrator/runs/beta_p7p_codex_cli/team_best.csv`: task127 team-best is Aditya cost 396, points 19.0186. The 396 graph charges `markers` `[1,4,2,3]` F32 = 96 B, `markers_f16` `[1,4,2,3]` = 48 B, `compact` `[1,5,2,3]` F16 = 60 B, plus params `W_paint` 160 + `W_desc` 20 + Slice inits 12.

The 330 candidate replaces Slice+Cast+F16 descriptor Conv with one F32 1x1 Conv using `strides=[4,4]` and negative crop pads `[-1,-1,-24,-20]`. That Conv emits only `compact` `[1,5,2,3]` F32 = 120 B. Params are `W_paint` `[5,2,4,4]` = 160 and `W_desc` `[5,10,1,1]` = 50. Net versus 396: memory -84, params +18, cost -66. Static score and full `--arcgen 266` profile both report 330.

The prompt's remaining lever was to remove the two zero descriptor channels. They are structurally serving `group=5` alignment: output groups `(0,1)` and `(2,3)` are placeholders, group `(4,5)` emits gray channel 5 from the panel-exists descriptor, group `(6,7)` emits colors 6/7 from `1-vs-2`, and group `(8,9)` emits colors 8/9 from `3-vs-4`. If the compact tensor is cut to 3 channels, `ConvTranspose` cannot use `group=5` because the input channel count is no longer divisible by 5, so the painter becomes dense `group=1`: memory 72 + `W_desc` 30 + `W_paint` 480 = 582. A 4-channel `group=2` layout still prices 96 + 40 + 320 = 456 and leaves all useful outputs 5..9 in one 2-feature group. The only nominal sub-396 regroup is 2 dense descriptor channels without bias (48 + 20 + 320 = 388), but a no-bias 2D homogeneous painter cannot make channel 5 positive for all four marker codes while also separating four one-vs-all color channels. Adding the missing affine bias costs 10 params, raising that family to 398 before gates. Therefore no prompt-derived regroup beats either 330 or the stale 396 baseline.

The prompt's intended paint-kernel shrink was tested structurally and rejected. In the team-best `W_paint`, colored blocks use offsets `[1:4,1:4]`, but gray separators use the top row and left column of the same 4x4 stamp. A 3x3 kernel can paint panels or separators depending on alignment, but cannot do both without adding another charged stage; the cheapest standalone 3x3 variant loses gray separators.

Legacy 900 note, now superseded: LIVE paid for intermediate cropped/spread tensors: `[1,4,7,11]` F32 marker slice (1,232 B), several `[1,1,7,11]` F32/BOOL planes, a `[1,10,7,11]` BOOL Concat (770 B), and 119 params. The single-final-Conv rewrite made the expensive spatial/color expansion the final node, which is skipped by `calculate_memory`.

Floor proof: final Conv over the original one-hot input is the zero-memory params-only route. Squeeze audit kill numbers: (1) kernel-size collapse is dead because the staged weight has 32 nonzero off-center taps, max abs off-center = 1.0; the 1x1/class-LUT-per-pixel jackpot does not apply. (2) spatial separability exists per active channel pair (`max_pair_rank=1`; global flattening ranks: `OCxIC_spatial=2`, all channel/spatial splits tested = 5), but a scored two-Conv split needs a counted best-case `[1,5,30,30]` F32 intermediate, so even the optimized 5-feature separable route costs `18,000 memory + 300 params = 18,300`, worse than 900. (3) grouped Conv is dead under fixed channel order: `groups=2` would charge 450 params but outputs 6..9 are confined to inputs 5..9 while they need inputs 1..4; `groups=5` (180 params) and `groups=10` (90 params) fail the same partition test. Dense `Conv(group=1)` therefore costs exactly `10*10*3*3 = 900` params and no memory because it writes `output`. QLinearConv/ConvInteger keep a dense weight surface and add scalar params; dtype changes do not reduce params because the scorer counts elements. Crop-then-final-Conv is at least `5*7*11*4 + 10*5*3*3 = 1,990`. Incumbent bool Pad/Concat is 4,046. Equal-tail pays the fixed 900-byte full canvas plus extraction/spread glue and is a documented #81 loser for task127's 77-cell bool prepad. Where/overlay needs at least a full condition/replacement plane. Einsum/contraction needs separate spatial selectors for 3x3 painting and gray identity, above 900 before channel maps. Broadcast/Add/Mul/BitwiseAnd finals cannot create local 3x3 spread without a counted plane. No enumerated final-op family beats 900.

## Don't-do log

- Do not shrink the current ConvTranspose paint kernel from 4x4 to 3x3 as a standalone change. The extra top row/left column paints gray separators; deleting it passes the panel-color intuition but fails the actual output.
- Do not rework this into Equal-tail: #81 explicitly lists task127 (77-cell BOOL prepad) as a sweep-verified loser, and the final-Conv route is already 900 exact-profile.
- Do not retry dropping the two zero descriptor channels without a new final-op family. Under `ConvTranspose`, the regrouped painter either becomes dense and costs at least 456/582, or the only 2-channel dense price below 396 is algebraically unable to express gray separators plus four marker colors without a bias that lifts it to 398.
- Do not preserve channel 0/background logic from LIVE. Generator/source and 200267 A/B pairs show the active output contains only colors 5..9; outside-active cells are all-zero padding.
- Do not use cropped/grouped Conv unless it beats 900 after counted crop/reorder memory; the cheapest cropped direct route prices at roughly 1,990.
- Do not split the 3x3 all-ones kernels into 3x1 then 1x3 Conv for shipping. The algebraic rank is 1, but the intermediate plane is counted; best-case split cost is 18,300, not 600.
- Do not pursue the `Cin=2, group=2` painter layout (prices 228, or 238 with a 10-param ConvTranspose bias — the only nominal sub-330 layout in the full price sweep). PROVED dead 2026-06-24: the harness decode is `decode_to_grid` = "the unique channel with value `>0`" (`tools/ng_harness/encode.py:57`), NOT argmax. With `group=2,Cin=2`, all five active outputs 5..9 are driven by a single scalar descriptor `d` per panel (input ch1 → output group {5..9}). A `>0` test on an affine `w_k*d+b_k` is a single ray in `d`; a ray can isolate only an EXTREME of the four color values `{a1..a4}`, and there are only 2 extremes (min,max) — so at most 2 of the 4 colors can be made the unique-positive channel. 4-color one-hot is impossible for ANY descriptor values. (Generator confirms every panel always carries a marker — no empty-panel `d=0` escape; `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_54d9e175.py:27,37`.) This is the rigorous root of the prior "two-channel dense cannot express gray + four one-vs-all colors" note. Three active descriptor channels (exists, c1-vs-c2, c3-vs-c4) are genuinely required; with `group=5` they price exactly 330.
